tools.name: search_legal_templates
tools.description: Search legal document templates on forms-legal.com (tenancy agreements, NDAs, wills, employment contracts, powers of attorney, deeds of sale and more) for 36 jurisdictions. Returns ranked matches with the canonical page URL, country, category, the statute the template references and a short summary.

tools.name: get_citation
tools.description: Return a formatted citation of a forms-legal.com page (a document template page, /nda-by-country, /compare, /datasets/legal-templates, a /glossary term, a /blog post or /press). Formats: apa (default), mla, chicago, bibtex, ris, csl (CSL-JSON for Zotero/Mendeley/Pandoc), datacite.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_legal_templates, get_citation · Private data: search_legal_templates, get_citation · Public sink: get_citation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_legal_templates, get_citation · Private data: search_legal_templates, get_citation · Public sink: get_citation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
